scope: Engine assertions, actual event handlers in a modeled DOM, and native Canvas rendering. Browser layout, live pointer/touch, screen reader and real download behavior are not verified.

results.name: Zero force neither invents motion, energy, damage nor salvage
Impact produces a finite response and settles
A vertical impulse has no horizontal response
Paused state does not advance
Aging and exposure reduce capacity for each of six materials
Source recovery percentages retained
Repair consumes finite input, restores up to 25%, and retains age
Repair cannot restore collapsed works or operate without stock
Destruction disconnects service, blocks ground, and creates finite rubble
Salvage transfers once, clears footprint, and does not restore service
Rebuilding spends a full specimen mass and exhausts repeated cycles
Seismic and storm scenarios reach collapse through the force model
Baseline is an independent snapshot
Fixed-step results do not depend on frame grouping
All 120 material/structure/force combinations remain finite at severe age
Invalid numeric and enum inputs are bounded before simulation
Tactical hex round trips and shares exact neighboring edge vertices
Natural and tactical views render distinctly without mutating the specimen
All five structure and three scale render paths execute
Collapsed, aged, selected, and cleared views render
Reduced motion suppresses displacement and falling-debris animation without changing data
Every HTML ID is unique and local asset links resolve
Actual UI material, structure, force, and range controls prepare the chosen specimen
Scenario preset selects coherent material, structure, age and forcing
Apply, pause, single-step, and compare handlers work
Hex and reduced-motion toggles preserve physics state
Ground inspection resolves hidden hex coordinates
Age advancement updates model and visible control values
Destruction, salvage, and rebuild controls obey lifecycle guards
Visual validation renders matched views and saves a three-criterion review
Material atlas and model notes navigation work
Cold reload preserves current results, stock and review without resuming force
